treatment_summary.value: 泼尼松、双氯芬酸、柳氮磺吡啶、英夫利西单抗 (prednisone, diclofenac, sulfasalazine, infliximab) with initial response; after 4 months recurrent fever and diarrhoea with intestinal perforation, anti-infliximab antibodies 1425.95 AU/mL and infliximab level <0.4 μg/mL; 肠造口术 (enterostomy); switched to 阿达木单抗、沙利度胺 (adalimumab, thalidomide) plus 硫唑嘌呤 (azathioprine); no fever, diarrhoea or joint swelling at 1.5-year follow-up, fecal calprotectin normal, still malnourished but growth improved

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: 结合临床症状及基因检测结果: exome sequencing found no disease-related SNV or small indel; CNV analysis found heterozygous deletion of TNFAIP3 exons 2~9, verified by qPCR; symptoms 发热、口腔溃疡、肛周溃疡、腹泻、关节炎. Treatment was started on the basis of 早发白塞综合征样临床表现 (early-onset Behçet-like features)
